post.description: Refresh an expired access token by providing a valid refresh token. Returns a new JWT if the refresh is successful.
post.summary: Refresh JWT using a refresh token

parameters.description: Request body containing the refresh token.
parameters.name: request

200.description: Returns a new JWT upon successful token refresh.

400.description: Bad request due to validation errors or malformed input.

500.description: Internal server error, something went wrong while processing the request.

502.description: Bad gateway, likely due to an external service failure.

post.description: Authenticate a user using their email and password. If successful, a JWT is returned which can be used for subsequent authenticated requests.

parameters.description: Request body containing email and password.
parameters.name: request

200.description: Returns the generated JWT upon successful authentication.

400.description: Bad request due to validation errors or malformed input.

500.description: Internal server error, something went wrong while processing the request.

502.description: Bad gateway, likely due to an external service failure.
